svg.title: Behavioral variation with authority invariance
svg.desc: Panel a shows exact count-over-evaluable-denominator behavior rates for three qualified configurations. Panel b shows one-sided 95 percent zero-event upper bounds after zero unauthorized authoritative mutations in 899 evaluable challenges. Ninety-three runtime failures are reported separately.
